# Upstream: Bump

Pip vendors the gesture engine from [Bump](https://github.com/Roshan-Rengadurai/bump) by Roshan Rengadurai, MIT licensed. License text: `Vendor/Bump/LICENSE`.

Vendored files (unmodified unless noted below):
- `Sources/Bump/Core/*` — GestureEngine + supporting core types
- `Sources/Bump/Permissions/Permissions.swift`
- `Sources/Bump/Models/Gesture.swift`, `Sources/Bump/Models/AppContext.swift`
- `Package.swift` (kept for reference under Vendor/Bump; Pip's root Package.swift compiles only the portable core)

## Patch ledger
(none yet — any local modification to vendored files gets an entry here with date + reason)
